description: Submit changed URLs in bulk to IndexNow search engines: Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam, Yep; not Google. Needs an IndexNow key hosted on the site at https://<host>/<key>.txt (write; supports dryRun)

dryRun.description: If true, report what would be submitted without notifying the endpoint

endpoint.description: IndexNow endpoint to notify; participating engines share submissions

key.description: IndexNow key; defaults to SEO_MCP_INDEXNOW_KEY. The same key must be hosted on the site as a text file at https://<host>/<key>.txt (or at keyLocation) containing only the key

keyLocation.description: URL of the hosted key file when it is not https://<host>/<key>.txt

urls.description: Changed page URLs; one submission covers one host

name: indexnow_submit
